metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 command-line program in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with its [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It accepts `--input` and `--output`, inspects base64 LAS files into JSON, and renders LAS files from the dataset schema.

The program builds with `cmake -S output -B build && cmake --build build`. I also verified that the supplied format 6 example renders and inspects successfully.
